codewords.expansion: IMOL modules start with `module <name>` optional same-line `@id("...")`. Then optional workshop, imports, plans, tools, types, functions. Workshop must appear before imports when present.
Use `import path.dotted as alias`. Resolved to `path/dotted.imol` under project root.
`workshop` block: `allow_net`, `allow_write`, `bind <prefix>` lines, closed with `end`. Binds gate extern keys at check and run.
`plan` block contains `invoke <tool> { fields }` lines only. `run plan` in main runs plan when session is approved.
`tool <name> from <extern.key> [@io|@net|@pure]...` then record input `->` output type on next line.
`type Name = ...` or `@id` on line before `type`. Sum: `Ok T | Err T`. Records: `{ field: Type, ... }`.
`@attrs*` then `function name(params) -> Ret` body stmts `end`. Every runnable module needs `function main() -> Unit`.
`match expr` arms: `Variant bind -> expr` or `_ -> expr`, closed with `end`. Must be exhaustive for sum types.
`invoke <tool_name> { field: expr, ... }` in expression position. Tool must be declared in module or imports.
Mark pure tools/functions with `@pure` when no IO/net/unsafe.
`@io` on functions/tools using IO. Workshop must allow via bind/capabilities.
`@net` requires `workshop allow_net true` and session allowance.
`@unsafe` / `std.fs.write` needs `allow_write true` in workshop and `--approve` to take effect.
Agent loop: (1) `imol agent check` before edits (2) prefer `imol agent patch` with `@id` (3) `imol agent workshop-plan` before side effects (4) never `--approve` unless user asked.
tool_policy: Run imol agent check before proposing IMOL source changes.

codewords.expansion: `imol agent check [file]` → JSON `{ ok, has_holes, diagnostics, entry, spec_version: "0.4" }` on stdout.
tool_policy: Use imol agent check and fix diagnostics before next edit.

codewords.expansion: `imol agent fmt-check <file>` → `{ ok, changed, spec_version }`. Canonical IR is fmt output.
`imol agent patch <file> <patches.json>` applies in memory; returns `{ output, check: { ok, diagnostics } }`; does not write disk.
tool_policy: Prefer patch JSON over rewriting entire .imol files.

codewords.expansion: `imol agent workshop-plan [file]` dry-runs plan invokes; `{ trace, state, trace_path, spec_version }`. Use before suggesting FS/tool effects.
tool_policy: Run imol agent workshop-plan before suggesting invoke/run side effects.

codewords.expansion: All agent stdout JSON includes `spec_version: "0.4"`. Schema: packages/imol-spec/agent-api.json.
Do not pass `--approve` on `imol run` or `imol workshop` unless the user explicitly requested execution.
tool_policy: Block --approve unless user explicitly requested side effects.

codewords.expansion: Tag declarations with `@id("stable-id")` on same line as module or line before function/type/tool. Patch ops target ids.
Patch op `replace_decl_by_id` with `id` and `source` (single decl snippet). See patch-schema.json.
Patch op `insert_after_id`: insert new declaration after the declaration with given `@id`.
Patch op `delete_decl_by_id`: remove declaration by `@id`.
If module has `plan` and workshop runs without `--approve`, only plan invokes dry-run; `main` not executed; state `Planned`.
Full execution including `run plan` requires `imol run --approve` or `imol workshop --approve`.
Workshop `--dry-run` traces invokes/externs without performing IO writes.
Traces under `.imol-trace/<module>.jsonl`. `imol workshop trace` defaults to last-trace.json pointer.
`imol workshop replay planned.jsonl executed.jsonl` compares kind/tool/extern/args_digest.
Bundled extern keys: std.fs.*, tools.filesystem.read. Dynamic `mcp.*` keys allowed when workshop includes `bind tools.mcp`. Unknown keys → E_EXTERN.
Tool `from std.fs.read` with `{ path: Text }` input; requires `bind std.fs` in workshop.
`std.fs.write` requires workshop `allow_write true`, bind std.fs, and `--approve`; without approval it returns Err.
After import merge, duplicate tool/function/type names → E_IMPORT_COLLISION. Use unique names across child modules.
CLI check/run/workshop load entry file and merge imported .imol modules recursively.
Common pattern: `type Result = Ok Text | Err Text` for tools and IO.
Builtins: Unit, Bool, Int, Text, Never. No implicit casts.
`fail(msg)` and Never return type for exhaustive error paths.
Formatted source is canonical IR. Use `imol fmt --write` to normalize before patch/check.
Diagnostics include code, message, span, optional decl_id when error inside `@id` decl.
`imol.json` / `imol.toml` with `entry` path; check/run without file arg uses manifest entry.
`imol tools import mcp.json [out.imol]` emits workshop with `bind tools.mcp` and tools `from mcp.<name>`.
`imol run [file]` requires check pass and `function main()`.
`run plan` stmt blocked unless `--approve` / planApproved.
Open holes fail check unless `--allow-holes`. Runtime cannot execute holes.
Golden examples must parse→fmt→parse and pass check. Run `npm run conformance`.
Statement `if cond` then branch stmts optional `else` branch `end` (not C-style braces).
`let name Type = expr` or infer from expr in statement position.
`import std.io as io` then `io.println(text)` for stdout IO.
Checker enforces record/sum/call types and exhaustive match. Fix type errors before run.
Effect annotations must align with tool/function body and workshop capabilities.
Agent subcommand failures emit `{ ok: false, error, spec_version: "0.4" }` on stdout.
`imol skill route "task"` selects codewords from flat codebook and compiles minimal packet (ISD/CSD layer).
IMOL-AgentBench compares no-doc vs cheat-sheet vs full SPEC vs CSD packet token budget and codeword recall.
Oracle-labeled trajectories: query + codeword_ids + ok from imol check on mutated examples.
Train sparse router weights from oracle trajectories; save to codebook/router-weights.json.
Grammar v2: repair pipeline + parseWithRepair + fmt. `imol agent sanitize`, MCP `imol_agent_sanitize`, `imol grammar show|repair`. See GRAMMAR.ebnf.
tool_policy: Run imol agent sanitize on raw LLM IMOL before imol agent check.

codewords.expansion: `imol lsp` stdio language server wraps checkModule; publishes diagnostics on open/save for `*.imol` files.
`std.shell.exec` + `bind std.shell` typechecks; runtime returns Err until allow_shell execution lands. See docs/ROADMAP_RUNTIME.md.
Every `from mcp.*` tool requires workshop `bind tools.mcp` (or `bind mcp`).
`imol agent loop` / MCP `imol_agent_loop` runs prepare → patch|LLM → sanitize → check → workshop-plan. See docs/AGENT_AUTOMATION.md.
tool_policy: Use imol agent loop or imol_agent_loop for scripted oracle compliance.

codewords.expansion: MCP loop: imol_skill_prepare → edit / imol_agent_patch → imol_agent_sanitize (optional) → imol_agent_check → imol_agent_workshop_plan. CLI: imol agent * equivalents.
tool_policy: Use imol MCP oracle tools when the imol server is green.
